main_text.head: XCIII.
main_text.p: Occultos fallacis aulæ fcopulos, amicitiæ fimulacra & honorum imitamenta, vir magnus vix effugiet.

Retracto in urbem à copiis Germanico, quafi defide-rium abfentis ferre Tiberius non potuiffet, teftandæ amicitiæ trecenos plebi feftertios viritim dedit, feque-collegam confulatui ejus deftinavit. feftertios eos fi-ftulam aucupariam, confulatum vifcum Germanicus judicavit, & ipfe Tiberius præfentem Germanici ho-norem, in urbe ad omnia mobili, & inclinatione non dubia,.

page.notes: The marginal note "Caeter hono-rarius." is uncertain in its first word; it could read "Caret" or "Career". The sentence "amicitiæ trecenos plebi ... feque-collegam" and the words "deftinavit", "eos fi-" and "confulatum vifcum" are hard to read on the scan and may be misread. The phrase "suspicaci principi" and "fufpe&us" are copied as far as the letters show; the initial letter of "fuspicaci" is doubtful. The final line "dubia,." is as printed. The page number "8o" is as printed.
